title: A Comparison of Laboratory Versus Point of Care (Bedside) APTT Testing
brief_summary: The overall aim of the study is to determine whether point-of-care (bedside) Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (APTT) testing would be better than laboratory APTT testing in the PICU population (restricted to children under 16 years of age).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients admitted to Paediatric Intensive Care Unit under the age of 16 years

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
study_population: Patients admitted to Paediatric Intensive Care Unit under the age of 16 years
